detail: All association summaries include beta/SD and 95% CI.
Stage 14 applies BH within dataset/specification families.
Association inference clusters by gene; conditional inference also uses grouped sign flips.
Nuisance fitting and tuning use connected gene/sequence groups; HeLa is not used for tuning.
All outputs are explicitly observational/exploratory and prohibit causal language.
The entire restart phase occurs after the frozen main result was known.
Q, I2 and tau2 are reported, but only two cell lines make them unstable.
Equal/coverage weights are labelled sensitivity weights, not abundance.
Complete 401-nt and structure-coverage filters select a reduced population.
Permutation importance/SHAP boundaries are explicitly non-causal.
